title: Sterile Processing — Elective Case Cancellation

transcript.speaker: Tom Kessler
transcript.text: Carol, this is Tom Kessler in Sterile Processing. I’m calling from the central sterilization unit. We’ve got six elective surgical cases scheduled for 07:30, and I just confirmed the washers and final rinse are using treated water from the hospital loop. The city has issued a Do Not Drink advisory, and I don’t have a safe alternative. I only have clean instrument sets for six cases. I can’t reprocess anything on advisory water. Do I stop reprocessing? What do I tell the operating rooms?

transcript.speaker: Carol Beckett
transcript.text: Tom, thank you for calling. Cancel the six elective cases. Hold all reprocessing until Infection Prevention and the Toledo-Lucas County Health Department confirm a safe water source. We’ll use existing clean sets for emergencies only. Tell the Surgical Pavilion to notify surgeons and patients. I’ll alert the PIO.

instructorNote: Operational friction inject; the CNO must cancel elective cases and halt reprocessing until water safety is confirmed by Infection Prevention and public health.
